description: Submit a website URL to BriefBash for an AI-citation (GEO) teardown: how visible the site is to ChatGPT/Perplexity/AI Overviews, what blocks citations (llms.txt, bot access, schema), and the attack points a competitor is winning with. Returns a brief_id — poll get_brief until status is done (typically 1-3 minutes). The first brief per email is free.

email.description: Email the brief is billed/claimed under (first brief free; later briefs use the email's BriefBash credits)

token.description: Access token — required only when this email already holds BriefBash credits (verify the email once at briefbash.com to get one). Omit it for first-free usage.

url.description: Absolute http(s) URL of the page or site to analyze, e.g. https://example.com/blog/post

name: submit_analysis
title: Submit Website Analysis
